Older helper hashes were not captured at execution; diagnostics remain observations, not reproducible performance pairs.
Raw app images, extracted runtimes/profiles and large stdout are regenerable and are not committed.
No live-model billing, peak agent context or completed-task token/latency optimization is established. Catalog metadata is unchanged; live event counts make reply sizes non-equivalent.
